subject: NimbusCloud unapplied credit bucket & VAT mapping audit
messages:
From: NimbusCloud Billing <billing@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Ivy Tran <ivy.tran@financepartners.co.uk>
Date: 2028-05-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Unapplied credits & VAT tags on May statement

Hi Vivek,

We're reconciling May activity and noticed ~€137,420 of unapplied credits that are currently sitting in the EU suspense bucket (AR:4000-SUSP). Some of those credits appear to be linked to old refunds that were issued net of VAT, but in our feed we see VAT tagged at 0% while the original invoices carried 20% VAT. This is causing an overstatement of net AR in our ledger.

I've attached the May customer statement and a CSV extract of the unapplied items for your review (nimbus_statement_may2028.pdf, proposed_jv_2028-05.csv). Can your team confirm whether Redwood's invoice reissue process applied VAT adjustments incorrectly when we performed the crediting on Apr 26?

Short timeline ask: we need to close May books next Thursday (2028-05-25). If there is a ledger correction required on Redwood's side (journal to reclass VAT from suspense to VAT payable or apply credits against open invoices), can you confirm the proposed approach and an ETA?

Thanks,
Ivy Tran
Finance Operations
NimbusCloud

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Ivy Tran <ivy.tran@financepartners.co.uk>, NimbusCloud Billing <billing@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-20T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Unapplied credits & VAT tags on May statement

Thanks Ivy — appreciate the extract and the deadline callout.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I'll own coordination with Accounting; Grace will run a preliminary VAT mapping to confirm whether the credits were posted net.
- Laura will validate the customer-facing application of credits (which invoices were left open).
- Marcus to prepare a proposed journal (JV) to move the EU suspense VAT difference into VAT Payable and reduce AR, if that's the agreed approach.

Can Marcus and Grace aim to have a first-pass reconciliation and draft JV to me by EOD 2028-05-21? If yes, I'll review and we can route to Rishi for final sign-off before posting.

Vivek
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-21T08:26:00Z
Subject: RE: Unapplied credits & VAT tags on May statement

Vivek — looping in some initial notes after a quick pass on the CSV:

- Scope: 47 credit memo lines totaling €137,420 across three legal entities (Redwood EU Ltd, Redwood Services EMEA, Redwood UK Ltd).
- Pattern: ~€98k of the amount came from credits raised against invoices originally issued with 20% VAT. The credits posted on Apr 26 show VAT = 0% in our AR feed.
- Root cause hypothesis: our crediting process used a global credit template that defaulted VAT to 0% when the original invoice had a zeroed VAT field in the migration mapping for older invoices.

Action items for today: Marcus to produce a draft JV (CSV attached) that reverses the VAT impact from AR suspense into VAT payable and applies the net credit to corresponding invoice balances where possible. For the credits that can't be matched to invoices (legacy refunds >24 months), propose a write-off/collectibility assessment.

I'll attach a working workbook with entity split and matching status (vat_recon_workbook_May2028.xlsx). Marcus — can you confirm proposed ledger accounts to use and whether we should book an allowance for doubtful collectibility for the unmatched portion?

-Grace
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-21T14:49:00Z
Subject: Re: Unapplied credits & VAT tags on May statement

Attached is the proposed journal CSV (proposed_jv_2028-05.csv). Summary of the proposal:

- Journal lines: debit AR suspense (4000-SUSP) €137,420; credit VAT payable (2360-VAT) €22,900; credit AR net (1100-AR) €114,520.
- For 32 matched credits we will apply against open invoices (net apply flows). Remaining €18,900 relates to legacy refunds older than 24 months.
- For legacy portion, propose an allowance (contra AR account 1199-ALLOW) pending customer confirmation; if uncollectible after 90 days, book as write-off against bad debt expense (6200-BDE).

I've included a short narrative in the CSV to assist posting team and a mapping to legal entities. If agreed, I can create the JV in the ledger and queue for Rishi's approval.

-- Marcus
Manager, Accounting
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Ivy Tran <ivy.tran@financepartners.co.uk>, NimbusCloud Billing <billing@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T09:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Unapplied credits & VAT tags on May statement

Hi Ivy — thanks for flagging. I ran the customer application logs and can confirm: 32 credit memos were applied to invoices between Apr 26 and May 03; the remaining 15 credits were exported from our old billing system and did not carry the original VAT tag in the migration.

Operationally, we can do two things quickly:
1) For the 32 matched credits, I'll trigger the backapply so the invoices show as fully settled — this will reduce open AR immediately once the JV posts.
2) For the 15 legacy credits, can you confirm whether Nimbus would accept a receivable allowance or prefer we pursue a refund trace? If we pursue refunds, we will need written confirmation and a 30–45 day window for bank reconciliation.

Ivy, can you advise preferred treatment for the unmatched batch? If we don't hear back within 48 hours we'll plan to book the allowance per Marcus's note to avoid overstating AR at month-end.

Best,
Laura
Accounting Lead, Revenue Recognition
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Ivy Tran <ivy.tran@financepartners.co.uk>, NimbusCloud Billing <billing@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: 2028-05-23T17:41:00Z
Subject: Re: Unapplied credits & VAT tags on May statement

Thanks team — reviewed Marcus's JV and Grace/Laura's reconciliation. Approve the proposed journal and allowance approach with two conditions:

1) Post the JV in Redwood EU Ltd and Redwood UK Ltd as mapped in the CSV; include the JV narrative referencing NimbusCloud statement #MAY-2028 and this internal ticket ID R-8421.
2) For the €18,900 legacy credits, book an allowance (1199-ALLOW) and flag for collection outreach. If Nimbus confirms refund preference within 30 days, reverse the allowance and process the refund.

Marcus — you have sign-off to post. Laura — proceed with the 32 back-applies once the JV is posted and notify Ivy when complete. Ivy — appreciate a quick confirmation on refund vs allowance; if no response by 2028-05-25 09:00Z we'll proceed with the allowance booking.

Rishi
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
